mapper.insert: insert into platform_user_role (id, user_id, role_id, created_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: delete from platform_user_role where user_id = #{userId} and role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.`code` FROM platform_user_role ur INNER JOIN platform_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.`status` = 1 AND r.`scope` = 'PLATFORM'
